title: Repayment difficulty, restructuring and insurance - explained
content: Restructuring changes agreed repayment terms after review; it is not an automatic entitlement. Loan insurance is a separate contract with its own coverage and claims requirements, so repayment difficulty alone does not prove that a claim will be paid.
